question: Should compact skills prompts spend budget on shortened descriptions before preserving all skill identities, or should name/location/version identity coverage remain the non-negotiable compact floor?
rationale: Both choices are plausible product behavior for model-visible session context, but the current branch changes the tradeoff for existing tight-budget skill catalogs and needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Preserve Identity Floor
options.body: Keep current name/location/version coverage as the compact minimum and add descriptions only when the exact final rendered prompt has spare budget.

options.title: Accept Description Priority
options.body: Allow shortened descriptions to take budget before some skill identities, but require clear maintainer approval and exact-head real prompt proof.

options.title: Pause For Omitted-Key Recovery
options.body: Defer compact descriptions until the omitted-skill lookup work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/42637 settles the broader truncation recovery path.

recommendation.title: Preserve Identity Floor
recommendation.body: Keep current name/location/version coverage as the compact minimum and add descriptions only when the exact final rendered prompt has spare budget.
